newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Strathmore ups yr profit to NZ$1.29 mln.
newsitem.headline: Strathmore ups yr profit to NZ$1.29 mln.

text.p: Note - Strathmore Group Ltd is an investment company. Strathmore said this was the first year in which it had equity acounted its associated company interests -- Cadac Ltd and CES Communications Ltd.

"The equity accounting of these two investments has resulted in NZ$266,000 of associated company goodwill being written off in addition to the equity accounting of the Group's share losses of $247,000," Strathmore said. Both companies were expected to trade at a profit over the next financial year.

Strathmore said it repurchased 2.53 million of its own shares during the year at an average price of 24.7 cents per share. Strathmore said it intended to put a more proactive buyback arrangement in place, with the buyback price more closely reflecting the underlying value of the company.
